C0401.title: Tycoon 2FA Phishing Kit Targets Health Tech Firm, Causing $1.4M Loss
C0401.summary: In October 2025, a CFO at a Boston-based health tech company clicked a phishing email attachment disguised as a meeting invitation. They entered credentials and MFA code on a fake Microsoft 365 login page. Attackers used the Tycoon 2FA kit's adversary-in-the-middle reverse proxy to intercept session cookies in real time, then sent emails as the CEO to change payment account details, stealing $1.4
